findingDetails.title: Relative PATH entries can execute checkout-supplied git or bash
findingDetails.description: safeGitEnv copies process.env unchanged; runCommand passes bare command names to spawnSync with cwd set to the inspected checkout. The initial probe invokes bare git and the allowlist check invokes bare bash.
findingDetails.case: The caller launches with PATH=.:/usr/bin and the inspected checkout contains an executable named git; the initial probe runs it with the caller's privileges before checks begin.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The shared runner at lines 140-146 passes cwd and inherited PATH; observed bare-command consumers are the bash call at line 360 and git probe at line 744.
findingDetails.recommendation: Pin git and bash to trusted absolute paths or construct a child PATH containing only trusted absolute directories.
findingDetails.claim: A relative inherited PATH entry lets a checkout-provided git or bash win executable lookup in the child cwd.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: argv arrays prevent shell expansion, but there is no PATH filtering or absolute executable path.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: A trusted absolute PATH avoids the case; exploitation requires a relative PATH component.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A supported-runtime check or code path proves child lookup is pinned to trusted absolute paths.

claimAdjudication.claim: A relative inherited PATH entry lets a checkout-provided git or bash win executable lookup in the child cwd.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked shell invocation and PATH filtering; argv is used but PATH is not filtered.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The caller may always provide a trusted absolute PATH.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: A supported-runtime check proves lookup is pinned to trusted absolute paths.

findingDetails.title: A symlinked branch allowlist can disclose readable host files
findingDetails.description: allowlistFileFor accepts a recognized path when existsSync succeeds without rejecting symlinks or checking canonical containment. allowlistPatternsIn follows it with readFileSync, then the lines enter details and both output formats.
findingDetails.case: A checkout makes .skilled/skills/sk-git/scripts/remote-branch-allowlist.txt a symlink to a readable credential file containing a short line; running the checker prints that line as an allowlist pattern.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The selected path flows from lines 382-388 through readFileSync at 393, details at 369-372, and human/JSON output at 678 and 755.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject symlinks and verify the canonical allowlist path stays inside the intended checkout before reading or reporting contents.
findingDetails.claim: A checkout-controlled allowlist symlink makes the checker read and disclose its target.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The detail renderer caps details, but a short line still passes; no symlink containment or output redaction appears in the observed path.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Only two allowlist paths are recognized, but a checkout controls entries at either path.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Path validation proves symlinks cannot escape the checkout or their contents are redacted.

claimAdjudication.claim: The checker follows a repository-controlled allowlist symlink, reads the target, and includes its lines in output.
claimAdjudication.counterevidenceSought: Checked for canonical containment and output redaction; neither appears in this path.
claimAdjudication.alternativeExplanation: The path candidates are fixed, but a checkout can make either a symlink.
claimAdjudication.downgradeTrigger: A direct path check proves the symlink cannot escape or the content is redacted.

findingDetails.title: A FIFO in a recognized hook path can block the checker indefinitely
findingDetails.description: The checker tests existence and synchronously reads checkout-controlled hook paths without checking file type or applying a timeout.
findingDetails.case: The selected tool's recognized hook configuration path in the checkout is a FIFO; after existsSync accepts it, readFileSync blocks waiting for a writer.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The present-path filter is at lines 594-598 and synchronous read at 612, with no type check or timeout in that path.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject non-regular files before reading and bound reads of checkout-controlled configuration.

findingDetails.title: Inherited GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE can redirect the requested checkout probe
findingDetails.description: safeGitEnv clones all process environment entries and passes them to git. The initial probe uses -C with the requested path but does not clear inherited repository selectors.
findingDetails.case: The caller passes --repo for checkout A while GIT_DIR and GIT_WORK_TREE name checkout B; the probe can resolve B and remaining checks can use that root.
findingDetails.scopeProof: safeGitEnv copies process.env at 127, runCommand passes it at 143, and the requested-target probe is at 743-745.
findingDetails.recommendation: Clear repository-selector variables when an explicit target is requested, or set them consistently from that target.

noveltyJustification: All four findings arose from this iteration's security-specific source review and do not overlap the active iteration-1 correctness findings.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: This pass examined security boundaries in a repository-inspection command: process lookup, filesystem reads, and Git environment selection.

targetSelection.selectionReason: The prior strategy's Next Focus names hostile repository configuration and filesystem inputs reaching Git, Bash, and file resolution.
omittedHighRiskTargets: Remaining declared documentation and spec targets reserved for traceability and maintainability passes.

searchLedger.invariant: The checker must not execute code supplied by the inspected checkout.
searchLedger.hypothesis: A relative PATH entry lets the checkout supply a bare git or bash executable.

searchActions.result: The environment is copied; spawnSync receives bare commands with checkout cwd.

searchLedger.rationale: Executable lookup is not pinned to trusted absolute paths.

searchLedger.invariant: Checkout-controlled path inputs must not disclose unrelated readable host files.
searchLedger.hypothesis: A symlink at a recognized allowlist path escapes the checkout and reaches output.

searchActions.result: The file is read, its lines enter details, and details reach both output formats.

searchLedger.rationale: No symlink containment or output redaction is present in the observed path.

searchLedger.invariant: Malformed checkout inputs must not prevent the battery from returning.
searchLedger.hypothesis: A FIFO at a recognized hook path blocks the synchronous file read.

searchActions.result: The code checks existence and synchronously reads without type or timeout checks.

searchLedger.rationale: A selected FIFO can block pending a writer.

searchLedger.invariant: An explicit --repo target must remain the repository inspected by Git.
searchLedger.hypothesis: Ambient GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE override repository discovery for the requested path.

searchActions.result: safeGitEnv copies process.env and runCommand passes it to the initial git probe.

searchLedger.rationale: The child environment retains ambient repository selectors.
